title: ToolGrantCheck
description: Records the result of a ToolGrant validation or revocation check. Revoked or expired grants MUST fail closed: the check result is authoritative and the corresponding OperationCommand MUST be rejected. Every check emits a ledger event (OP_GRANT_VALIDATE or OP_GRANT_REVOKE).

check_id.description: Stable, globally unique identifier for this check record.

operation.description: Whether this record describes a validation or a revocation.

grant_id.description: Identifier of the Grant being checked.

checked_at.description: Timestamp at which the check was performed; used for TTL and expiry evaluation.

spiffe_id.description: SPIFFE identity of the principal requesting or performing the check.

valid.description: True only if the grant exists, has not expired, and has not been revoked.

expired.description: True if the grant's expires_at is in the past relative to checked_at.

revoked.description: True if the grant has been explicitly revoked via tool_grant.revoke.

revoked_at.description: Timestamp of the revocation event, present when revoked=true.

reason.description: Human-readable explanation of the check outcome.

trust_boundary_id.description: Optional reference to the TrustBoundary the grant was scoped to.

policy_hash.description: Hash of the policy used to evaluate grant validity.
